narrative.overview: The user approved an Apple Watch Activity-inspired concept: concentric pink and lime rings on a near-black, rounded floating window. The interface is a glanceable utility. Exact quota semantics matter more than decorative effects. This identity uses native Windows WPF typography, controls and vector rendering.
keyCharacteristics: Matte dark surface with stable pink and lime window identities.
Remaining quota rings paired with explicit remaining numbers in full view.
Separate full and compact compositions with local reset details.
Native Windows keyboard interaction and accessible quota semantics.
English-default, locale-aware copy with reversible live Settings preview.
Earned-reset availability with explicit spend confirmation and same-attempt recovery.

rules.name: The Quota Identity Rule
rules.body: Pink identifies five-hour quota and lime identifies weekly quota in both modes; warning states retain those identities.

rules.name: The Remaining Ring Rule
rules.body: Arcs encode remaining quota: full means all quota remains, empty means none remains. Full-view numbers and accessible values use the same semantics; compact values live in the tooltip.

rules.name: The Explicit Reset Rule
rules.body: Spending a reset requires confirmation with Cancel as default; an uncertain outcome retries the same persisted attempt.

dos: Do preserve the approved concentric-ring identity across both modes.
Do label absent windows as unavailable; do not invent a zero remaining value.
Do keep dates close to the quota they describe.
Do keep real quota data out of committed preview images.
Do retain visible keyboard focus and read-only accessible quota semantics.
Do preview language changes immediately and restore the previous language on Cancel.
Do distinguish earliest known expiry from complete expiry metadata.
Do keep reset spending explicit and preserve the same attempt for uncertain retries.
donts: Don't add an Apple logo, watch hardware frame, extra activity ring or decorative metrics.
